desc: 钴蓝斜切撞色底，水纹气泡讲补水，编号痛点与参数白卡收口
name: 钴蓝水感保湿精华水款

shots.intent: 搜索列表第一眼：产品全身立于水纹之上，干净合规拿点击。
主图一秒法则：一条主张加三枚圆牌，一秒讲清核心利益。
shots.textZone: lower cobalt band carries three circle chips; upper right cream area carries the headline slot

shots.intent: 用编号三宫格放大干燥缺水的真实困扰，承接首屏往下滑。
shots.textZone: two-line cobalt label beside each numbered tile, headline block top-left

shots.intent: 把补水机制翻译成看得见的动态水花与水泡，解释原理。
shots.textZone: three floating bubble chips on the left and right of the product

shots.intent: 用材质微距证明瓶身工艺与水感质地，建立品质信任。
把产品放进真实晨间护肤台面，让买家自我代入。
演示倒在化妆棉上的用法与清透质地，消除使用疑虑。
平铺三种容量规格，让买家一步选完不再犹豫。
shots.textZone: one small label tag under each unit

shots.intent: 把参数交回真实信息，用空白参数卡降风险而不编造数据。
shots.textZone: five row label and value slots on the right-hand card

shots.intent: 斜切蓝带加一句行动号召，完成详情页最后一步收口。
shots.textZone: one short call-to-action line on the cobalt band, upper left clear

style.backgroundSystem: cloud white #FFFFFF seamless field for packshots and info screens, warm cream #F3EDE4 for benefit and scene screens, one recurring periwinkle-cobalt #6F7BF0 diagonal colour band with blank white cards and circle chips as the graphic panels, cool aqua #CFE8F7 water field only on the mechanism screen
style.direction: premium cobalt-blue hydrating skincare detail-page commerce
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in #6F7BF0, blank circle chips and square tiles, no filled illustration and no badge artwork
style.lightingSystem: cool high-key studio light, large soft front-left key with a fill card on the shadow side, soft single-direction contact shadows, controlled specular only on wet glass, around 6000K
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium cobalt-blue hydrating skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cloud white #FFFFFF, warm cream #F3EDE4, periwinkle cobalt #6F7BF0 and graphite-blue text #2C3E4C; cool high-key studio lighting with a soft front-left key, fill card and single-direction soft contact shadows; one recurring diagonal cobalt colour band with blank white cards, circle chips and oversized ghost numerals as the only infographic components; modern geometric sans-serif with a two-tone boxed headline; thin single-weight line icon style in #6F7BF0, no filled illustration; water ripple and clear bubble motifs as the only decorative elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no real numbers, certificates or efficacy figures printed in frame
style.presentationRules: product upright and whole on every screen except the macro and the pad close-up; stable slight 3/4 hero angle and scale across the set; copy side stays clear so the bottle never gets occluded
style.surfaceSystem: matte wet stone #E8E2DA and neutral matte board #EFEAE3, plus a shallow clear water layer with concentric ripple rings
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; two-tone boxed headline built from an outlined block plus a solid cobalt block; oversized light ghost numerals behind numbered blocks; headline 32-44pt, subtitle 16-20pt, label 12-16pt; all rendered copy stays short and placeholder-driven
